prompt: Create a cinematic ultra-realistic alpine landscape at sunrise: a single young woman with brown hair in a braid sits quietly on a flat rock at the edge of a perfectly still mountain lake, viewed from behind, wearing a simple blue knee-length dress. She is the only human figure, small in the composition, centered slightly right of the lake’s vanishing point, gazing across the water toward towering snow-dusted mountains. The scene contains one calm reflective lake, one visible sunburst breaking over the left mountain ridge, and one set of circular ripples spreading from the rock into the foreground water. Surround the lake with rugged gray boulders, grasses, purple wildflowers, dark evergreen trees, and golden autumn larches along the right shoreline. The water should mirror the mountains, sky, trees, sun flare, and the seated figure with crisp but natural reflections. Use a wide panoramic 16:9 composition, dramatic depth, cool blue morning mist in the valley, warm golden sunlight touching the peaks and trees, soft volumetric rays, high dynamic range, rich natural textures, serene contemplative mood, sharp foreground rocks, atmospheric distant mountains, no text, no buildings, no extra people, no boats.

promptZh: 创作一张日出时分的电影级超写实高山景观：一位留着 棕色 编发辫的年轻女性，静静地坐在平静如镜的山湖边一块平坦的岩石上，背影视角，身穿一件简约的 蓝色 膝盖长度连衣裙。她是画面中唯一的人影，在构图中显得渺小，位于湖泊消失点略偏右的中心位置，凝视着水面彼端高耸且覆盖着积雪的山峰。场景包含一个平静的倒影湖泊，左侧山脊上方可见一抹破晓的太阳光芒，水面从岩石处向前景扩散出一圈涟漪。湖泊周围环绕着崎岖的灰色巨石、草丛、紫色野花、深色常青树，右侧岸边点缀着金色的秋季落叶松。水面应清晰而自然地倒映出山峦、天空、树木、太阳光晕以及坐着的女性身影。采用 16:9 宽画幅构图，强调戏剧性的景深，山谷中弥漫着冷蓝色的晨雾，温暖的金色阳光洒在山峰和树木上，柔和的体积光，高动态范围，丰富的自然纹理，宁静沉思的氛围，前景岩石锐利，远山大气，无文字，无建筑，无额外人物，无船只。
